name: Protopasta Bronze HTPLA
filament_notes:
Bronze-filled HTPLA. Material Data Table: 200C up to 24 mm3/s, 55C plate; avoid printing below 3 mm3/s; hard steel nozzle and gears recommended. TDS: 195C nozzle, 60C bed, density about 2.3 g/cm3 (the SDS says 2.5), about 97 m per 500 g.
Heat treat like HTPLA (TDS: 95-110C, 10+ minutes) to firm up parts.
